memberships.page_title: Filtered Regular Nilpotent Pencils in Dimension Five

statement: An everywhere-regular five-dimensional quadratic nilpotent line pencil whose kernel map spans P4 has saturated filtration degrees (-4,-2,0,2,4); every successive map is an isomorphism and the kernel map is the rational normal quartic.
